The following actions will give a chance to drop this pet:
• while Tracking
• while Bird snaring
• while Rabbit snaring
• while Butterfly netting (and barehanded)
• while Impling netting (only barehanded; those caught in Impetuous Impulses will not count)
• while Deadfall trapping
• while Box trapping
• while Net trapping
• while Pitfall trapping
• while Tortle trapping
• doing Falconry
• using Magic boxes
• playing Big Game Hunter
• catching kami in the Arc
• catching charming moths in the Wilderness
• catching chronicle fragments
• catching Charm sprites
• gathering from a decaying guard in the Croesus Front
• building traps at the Hunting lodge in Dream of Iaia
• doing the Hook a Duck activity at The Beach
The following actions will not give a chance to drop this pet:
• using protean traps or unstable protean traps
• playing a Minigame that rewards experience in this skill
• using a Divine hunter spot
• using a Hunting skill training dummy

In a purely mathematical format, the chance f of receiving a pet on any particular action is
f = \frac{T \times S}{50,000,000}
Where:
• T is the amount of game ticks taken per action
• S is the virtual skill level. At 200 million experience, a flat bonus of 50 is applied to this value
